entries.source: I took a break from work for too long! Now I need your help to meet my quota!
entries.translation: 我这假摸得有点久了! 现在得靠你帮我把指标凑上!

entries.source: In order to summon your Chicken Pet, you'll need to add it to your Pets Menu first.
entries.translation: 想召唤鸡宠物,得先把它加进宠物菜单。

styleMappings.In order to summon your Chicken Pet, you: 想召唤鸡宠物,得先把它加进

entries.sampleRaw: In order to summon your Chicken Pet, you'll need to add it to your §dPets Menu §rfirst.

entries.source: Take this Chicken Pet, it'll help you gather more crops!
entries.translation: 拿着这只鸡宠物,它能帮你多收作物!

entries.source: That Chicken Pet gives you  Farming Fortune, which gives you a chance to drop additional crops!
entries.translation: 这只鸡宠物会给你农业时运,有概率多掉作物!

entries.source: That Chicken Pet gives you ☘ Farming Fortune, which gives you a chance to drop additional crops!
entries.translation: 这只鸡宠物会给你 ☘ 农业时运,有概率多掉作物!

entries.source: The entrance to the Mushroom Desert sits atop a hill to the north.
entries.translation: 蘑菇沙漠的入口在北边的山顶上。

entries.source: The farm animals here provide a variety of resources.
entries.translation: 这儿的牲畜能出产各种资源。

entries.source: There you'll find resources only an experienced farmer can handle - cocoa beans, sugar cane, mushrooms, and cactus!
entries.translation: 那儿的资源只有老手才玩得转——可可豆、甘蔗、蘑菇,还有仙人掌!

entries.source: Those Fairy Souls scare off the animals.
entries.translation: 那些仙女之魂把动物都吓跑了。

entries.source: Try collecting some of the various crops on the island.
entries.translation: 去岛上各种庄稼都收一点试试。

entries.source: While Minions are great, the best way to gather resources is by hand.
entries.translation: 仆从是挺好,不过收资源最快的办法还是自己动手。

styleMappings.are great, the best way to gather resour: 是挺好,不过收资源最快的办法还是自己动手。

entries.source: You can find many more types of crops there!
entries.translation: 那边的作物种类多得多!

entries.source: You condemn me to doing my own work? How can you do this to me!
entries.translation: 你要逼我自己干活? 你怎么能这样对我!

entries.source: May your destiny be ridded with fortune.
entries.translation: 愿你的命运被好运缠身。
entries.sampleRaw: §fMay your destiny be ridded with fortune.

entries.source: Mortal, the time of reckoning is near. The Past will light the future.
entries.translation: 凡人,清算之时将至。过往将照亮未来。
entries.sampleRaw: §fMortal, the time of reckoning is near. The Past will light the future.

entries.source: Check the calendar, there should be another feast scheduled!
entries.translation: 看看日历,上面应该已经排好了下一场盛宴!
entries.sampleRaw: §fCheck the calendar, there should be another feast scheduled!

entries.source: That might've been our best feast yet!
entries.translation: 那或许是我们办得最好的一次盛宴!
entries.sampleRaw: §fThat might've been our best feast yet!

entries.source: We're hoping to run another one next Early Autumn!
entries.translation: 我们打算明年七月再办一场!
entries.sampleRaw: §fWe're hoping to run another one next Early Autumn!

entries.source: You won't be able to store any items in the Garden, you should keep them on your Private Island!
entries.translation: 花园里可存不了东西,你得把它们放回私人岛屿上!
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou won't be able to store any items in the Garden, you should keep them on your Private Island!

entries.source: We went to school for this!
entries.translation: 我们可是专门上学学过这个的!

entries.source: My job here is to make sure the lava flows and that the titanium shines.
entries.translation: 我在这儿的活儿,就是保证熔岩一直流、钛一直亮。
entries.sampleRaw: §fMy job here is to make sure the lava flows and that the titanium shines.

entries.source: These forges have been running at an endermite's pace!
entries.translation: 这些熔炉慢得像只末影螨!
entries.sampleRaw: §fThese forges have been running at an endermite's pace!

entries.source: Yep, it's mostly watching other people work!
entries.translation: 是啊,基本上就是看别人干活!
entries.sampleRaw: §fYep, it's mostly watching other people work!

entries.source: Have you found the Epic Giraffe yet?
entries.translation: 你找到史诗长颈鹿了吗?

entries.source: Hey there, I'm George the Pet Collector!
entries.translation: 你好,我是宠物收藏家 George!
entries.sampleRaw: §fHey there, I'm George the Pet Collector!

entries.source: I travel the world searching far and wide for the rarest pets I can find!
entries.translation: 我四处游历,就是为了寻找世上最稀有的宠物!
entries.sampleRaw: §fI travel the world searching far and wide for the rarest pets I can find!

entries.source: If you have any pets which need a new home I'd be happy to buy them off you!
entries.translation: 如果你的宠物需要一个新家,我很乐意买下它们!
entries.sampleRaw: §fIf you have any pets which need a new home I'd be happy to buy them off you!

entries.source: Enid and I are thrilled that our two children love it as much as we do!
entries.translation: Enid 和我可高兴了,两个孩子也跟我们一样喜欢钓鱼!

styleMappings.and I are thrilled that our two children: 和我可高兴了,两个孩子也跟我们一样喜欢钓鱼!

entries.sampleRaw: §9Enid §fand I are thrilled that our two children love it as much as we do!

entries.source: He saved my skin then, and I'm forever grateful to him.
entries.translation: 当时他救了我的命,我永远感激他。
entries.sampleRaw: §fHe saved my skin then, and I'm forever grateful to him.

entries.source: I prefer the open water. More peaceful, less Ghasts!
entries.translation: 我还是喜欢在开阔的水面钓鱼。清静多了,恶魂也少!
entries.sampleRaw: §fI prefer the open water. More peaceful, less Ghasts!

entries.source: I've only gone lava fishing a few times in my life.
entries.translation: 我这辈子也就试过几次熔岩钓鱼。

styleMappings.I've only gone: 我这辈子也就试过几次

entries.sampleRaw: §fI've only gone §clava fishing §fa few times in my life.

entries.source: Here, you can join me in drinking away your sorrows.
entries.translation: 来吧,你可以和我一起借酒消愁。
entries.sampleRaw: §fHere, you can join me in drinking away your sorrows.

entries.source: THEY'RE STEALING THE CRYSTAL! GET THEM!
entries.translation: 他们在偷水晶! 抓住他们!

entries.source: You do not belong here! Get out while you still can!
entries.translation: 你不该来这里! 趁还能走,赶紧出去!

entries.source: ... I've realized... those ladders... are just... too much...
entries.translation: ...我算是明白了...那些梯子...实在是...太折腾了...
entries.sampleRaw: §f... I've realized... those ladders... are just... too much...

entries.source: ... not built... for sloths... you see...
entries.translation: ...你看...这根本...不是给树懒爬的...
entries.sampleRaw: §f... not built... for sloths... you see...

entries.source: I spent... years... crafting... this magical scroll...
entries.translation: 我花了...好多年...才做出...这张魔法卷轴...
entries.sampleRaw: §fI spent... years... crafting... this magical scroll...

entries.source: With it... you can... skip the climb... effortlessly...
entries.translation: 有了它...你就不用爬了...轻轻松松...
entries.sampleRaw: §fWith it... you can... skip the climb... effortlessly...

entries.source: It's a great day to go for a run!
entries.sampleRaw: It's a great day to go for a run!

entries.source: You're always welcome to try the race again. Just run over the pressure plate to begin!
entries.translation: 随时欢迎你再跑一次! 踩上压力板就能开始。
entries.sampleRaw: You're always welcome to try the race again. Just run over the pressure plate to begin!

entries.source: They are both lying, the reward is in my chest!
entries.translation: 他们俩都在撒谎,奖励就在我的箱子里!

entries.source: Do you know what they would've done if they found me?
entries.translation: 要是被他们发现,你知道我会落得什么下场吗?
entries.sampleRaw: Do you know what they would've done if they found me?

entries.source: Oh, thank goodness! They sent someone to get me out of here.
entries.translation: 哦,谢天谢地! 他们终于派人来救我了。
entries.sampleRaw: Oh, thank goodness! They sent someone to get me out of here.

entries.source: Are you in the market for a Husbandry Axe?
entries.sampleRaw: §fAre you in the market for a Husbandry Axe?

entries.source: They'll help you gather drops from animals faster!
entries.translation: 有了它,从牲畜身上收东西能快不少!
entries.sampleRaw: §fThey'll help you gather drops from animals faster!

entries.source: Click me again to open the Iron Forger Shop!
entries.translation: 再点我一下就能打开熔铁匠商店!
entries.sampleRaw: §fClick me again to open the Iron Forger Shop!

entries.source: For my wares, you'll have to pay the iron price!
entries.translation: 想要我的货,就得付出铁的代价!
entries.sampleRaw: §fFor my wares, you'll have to pay the iron price!

entries.source: I've recently got into cooking, yesterday I made pasta carbonara, today I'm planning on baking a carrot cake.
entries.translation: 我最近迷上了做饭,昨天做了培根蛋面,今天打算烤个胡萝卜蛋糕。
entries.sampleRaw: §fI've recently got into cooking, yesterday I made pasta carbonara, today I'm planning on baking a carrot cake.

entries.source: Seriously though, I only accept Coins.
entries.translation: 不过说真的,我只收硬币。

entries.source: Will have to order some food today then.
entries.sampleRaw: §fWill have to order some food today then.

entries.source: Did you know that you gain additional ☘ Farming Fortune while on the Garden? You can check it in your SkyBlock Profile!
entries.translation: 你知道吗? 待在花园里能额外获得 ☘ 农业时运! 打开你的 空岛 档案就能看到。

styleMappings.? You can check it in your SkyBlock Prof: ! 打开你的 空岛 档案就能看到。

entries.source: Did you know that you gain additional ☘ Farming Fortune while on the The Garden? You can check it in your SkyBlock Profile!
entries.translation: 你知道吗? 待在花园里能额外获得 ☘ 农业时运! 打开你的 空岛 档案就能看到。

styleMappings.? You can check it in your SkyBlock Prof: ! 打开你的 空岛 档案就能看到。

entries.sampleRaw: §fDid you know that you gain additional §6☘ Farming Fortune §fwhile on the §aThe Garden§f? You can check it in your SkyBlock Profile!

entries.source: Thanks for the crops. See ya around.
entries.sampleRaw: §fThanks for the crops. See ya around.

entries.source: Check ye calendar eh? Or better yet, click me to learn more, eh!
entries.translation: 去翻翻你的日历呗? 或者干脆再点我一下,我细说给你听!
entries.sampleRaw: Check ye calendar eh? Or better yet, click me to learn more, eh!

entries.source: Come see me in the Hub to claim your reward!
entries.sampleRaw: Come see me in the §aHub §fto claim your reward!

entries.source: Come see me in the hub anyway!
entries.translation: 不管怎样,来大厅找我一趟吧!

entries.source: Gosh darn it matey, can't believe ya do me like that, eh?
entries.translation: 我的天哪,伙计,你真忍心这么对我?

entries.source: Hot diggity, that's a lot of medals! I gave ya some rewards, speak with me if you're interested in the rest.
entries.translation: 好家伙,这么多奖牌! 我先给你发一部分奖励,剩下的想要就再来找我。

entries.source: Howdy! Fine barn ye got there eh? Good lad, you think ye could get me some wheat, eh?
entries.translation: 嘿! 你这谷仓真不赖啊? 好小伙,能给我弄点小麦来不?
entries.sampleRaw: §fHowdy! Fine barn ye got there eh? Good lad, you think ye could get me some wheat, eh?

entries.translation: 嘿! 今天天气不错啊?

entries.source: I organize farming contests once every few days!
entries.translation: 我隔几天就办一场农业竞赛!
entries.sampleRaw: I organize farming contests once every few days!

entries.source: Let me count the final results eh?
entries.sampleRaw: §fLet me count the final results eh?

entries.source: Let me count the results eh?
Thanks a lot matey. That'll help ye prepare my next farming contest eh?
entries.translation: 多谢了伙计。这下我下一场农业竞赛就好准备了.
entries.sampleRaw: §fThanks a lot matey. That'll help ye prepare my next farming contest eh?

entries.source: Uh oh! Couldn't figure out how well ya did!
entries.translation: 糟糕! 我没算出来你这场发挥得怎么样!

entries.source: Well, well! I coordinate a farming contest every few SkyBlock days, eh?
entries.translation: 好嘛,好嘛! 每隔几个空岛日,我就张罗一场农业竞赛,懂吧?

styleMappings.Well, well! I coordinate a: 好嘛,好嘛! 每隔几个空岛日,我就张罗一场

entries.sampleRaw: Well, well! I coordinate a §efarming contest §revery few SkyBlock days, eh?

entries.source: You wouldn't happen to be one mighty farmer eh?
entries.translation: 你该不会就是那位了不起的农夫吧,嗯哼?
entries.sampleRaw: You wouldn't happen to be one mighty farmer eh?

entries.source: You wouldn't happen to be one mighty fine farmer eh?
entries.translation: 你该不会就是那位了不起的好农夫吧,嗯哼?
✆ 希望能看到你下地干活!

entries.source: ✆ I simply enjoy a more simple life, ye?
entries.translation: ✆ 我只是更喜欢简简单单地过日子,懂吧?

entries.source: ✆ I'm far from stupid, don't get me wrong, eh.
entries.translation: ✆ 别误会,我可一点都不傻,啊。

entries.source: ✆ Ma' always told me to worry of stuff I don't understand.
entries.translation: ✆ 我妈总说,搞不懂的东西要多留个心眼。

entries.source: ✆ Ya sure can add my contact, against 10 Jacob's Ticket, eh?
entries.translation: ✆ 加我当然行,拿 10 张 Jacob 的票券来换,啊?

entries.source: ✆ Ya won't call me too often, eh?
entries.translation: ✆ 你不会老给我打电话吧?

entries.source: An investment in knowledge pays the best interest.
entries.sampleRaw: An investment in knowledge pays the best interest.

entries.source: Empty pockets never held anyone back. Only empty heads and empty hearts can do that.
entries.translation: 空空的口袋从未阻挡过任何人,只有空洞的头脑和心灵才会。
entries.sampleRaw: Empty pockets never held anyone back. Only empty heads and empty hearts can do that.

entries.source: If you live for having it all, what you have is never enough.
entries.translation: 若你只为拥有一切而活,那你拥有多少都永远不够。
entries.sampleRaw: If you live for having it all, what you have is never enough.

entries.source: The real measure of your wealth is how much you'd be worth if you lost all your coins.
entries.translation: 衡量财富的真正标准,是失去所有硬币后你还值多少。

entries.source: If you can prove to me you're a real archer I'll forge you arrows whenever you need them.
entries.translation: 只要向我证明你是真正的弓箭手,往后缺箭就来找我锻造。

entries.source: Ready to test your skills? Step on the pressure plate and all the targets will light up, if you can shoot them all in 25 seconds, I'll know you're the real deal.
entries.translation: 准备好大显身手了吗? 踏上压力板后,所有目标都会亮起。若你能在 25 秒内将它们全部射中,我就承认你是真材实料。

entries.source: And if you come accross duplicates of the same Chip, don't worry, you'll be able to upgrade them to EPIC and LEGENDARY rarity, boosting their maximum level and effectiveness even further!
entries.translation: 要是捡到重复的芯片也别急,可以拿来把它升到史诗和传说稀有度,等级上限和效果都会更进一步!

entries.translation: 不过有个坎——到了 15 级,得先强化一次才能继续升。30 级也一样。

entries.translation: 芯片到处都能找到,解锁之后就可以开始升级了。

styleMappings.can be found all over the place, and onc: 到处都能找到,解锁之后就可以开始升级了。

entries.source: Every crop you harvest gives your tool experience, leveling it up over time.
entries.translation: 你每收一株作物,农具就攒一点经验,慢慢就升级了。

styleMappings.Every crop you harvest gives your tool: 你每收一株作物,农具就攒一点

entries.translation: 不错! 我把芯片菜单加进你的 空岛 菜单了(在花园里的时候),以后找起来更方便。

entries.translation: 等你弄到一件,就过来找我,我教你芯片是怎么回事!

styleMappings.Once you get your hands on one, swing by: 等你弄到一件,就过来找我,我教你

entries.source: These Specialized Farming Tools are a game changer! You can level them and upgrade to become even more powerful.
entries.translation: 这些专精农具能彻底改变你的种田方式! 它们可以升级、可以强化,越用越强。

entries.translation: 它们可不是摆设,越用越强!

entries.translation: 现在芯片想要多少有多少,记得用播尘不断升级它们!

entries.source: You should hear what Sam has to say first before talking to me!
entries.translation: 先去听听 Sam 怎么说,再来找我!
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou should hear what §bSam §fhas to say first before talking to me!

entries.source: Cocoa Beans only grow on one type of tree!
entries.translation: 可可豆只长在一种树上!

entries.source: Did you know Slimes can spawn near the void?
entries.translation: 你知道吗? 史莱姆会在虚空边上刷出来。

entries.source: I don't talk to guests! Go away!
entries.translation: 我不跟客人说话! 走开!

entries.source: I refuse to speak with guests!
I seem to be having some issues warping you... Check again soon!
entries.translation: 我好像没法把你传送过去……稍后再试试!

entries.source: I've heard that scary monsters can attack your island sometime in Autumn.
entries.translation: 听说到了八月,会有可怕的怪物袭击你的岛。

entries.source: In my opinion, Magma Cubes are just fiery slimes.
entries.translation: 要我说,岩浆怪不过是着了火的史莱姆。

entries.source: It's the holiday season in SkyBlock and that can only mean one thing...
entries.translation: 空岛 的节日季到了,这只意味着一件事……
Jerry 的工坊遭到袭击了!

entries.source: My expertise doesn't come for free!
entries.translation: 我的专业意见可不是免费的!

entries.source: Off you go! Thanks for the help!
Pigmen are great at hoarding wealth.
Progress as far as you can by killing mobs, gaining collection, and using minions.
entries.translation: 击杀生物、积累收藏品、使用仆从,能走多远走多远。

entries.source: Rabbits can spawn in different biomes!
entries.translation: 兔子会在不同的生物群系里刷出来!

entries.source: Save the Jerrys' home and ensure all of SkyBlock gets to receive Gifts!
entries.translation: 救救 Jerry 们的家园,让整个 空岛 都能收到礼物!

styleMappings.Save the Jerrys' home and ensure all of: 救救 Jerry 们的家园,让整个 空岛 都能收到

entries.sampleRaw: §fSave the Jerrys' home and ensure all of SkyBlock gets to receive §aGifts§f!

entries.source: Shiny creatures can drop shiny things!
entries.translation: 闪亮的生物会掉闪亮的东西!

entries.source: Thank you for your bravery! Good luck!
entries.translation: 感谢你的勇气! 祝你好运!

entries.source: The SkyBlock universe is full of islands to explore and resources to discover!
entries.translation: 空岛 世界中有无数岛屿等你探索,也有各种资源等你发现!
entries.sampleRaw: The SkyBlock universe is full of islands to explore and resources to discover!

entries.source: The only way to obtain Emeralds is to trade for them!
entries.translation: 绿宝石只能靠交易换来!

entries.source: There is no escape...you are stranded!
entries.translation: 无处可逃……你被困在这里了!

entries.source: This is not my realm. I must return. Thank you.
entries.translation: 此地非我领域。我必须回去了。谢谢你。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThis is not my realm. I must return. Thank you.

entries.source: This place desperately needs more Iron Golems!
entries.translation: 这地方急需更多铁傀儡!

entries.source: Use the Portal to warp to the first of those islands - the SkyBlock Hub!
entries.translation: 使用传送门前往其中的第一座岛屿——空岛 中心岛!

styleMappings.to warp to the first of those islands -: 前往其中的第一座岛屿——空岛 中心岛!

entries.sampleRaw: Use the §5Portal §fto warp to the first of those islands - the SkyBlock Hub!

entries.source: Villagers tend to have cool trades!
entries.translation: 村民手里常有不错的交易!

entries.source: Villagers tend to have sweet trades!
entries.translation: 村民手里常有划算的交易!

entries.source: Wait, how did I get here? [2/2]
You are truly a hero! Thank you for helping us!
entries.translation: 你真是个英雄! 谢谢你帮助我们!

entries.source: Your SkyBlock island is all you have!
entries.translation: 你的 空岛 岛屿就是你的全部!

entries.source: Your SkyBlock island is part of a much larger universe.
entries.translation: 你的 空岛 岛屿只是广阔世界的一部分。
entries.sampleRaw: Your SkyBlock island is part of a much larger universe.

entries.source: Your SkyBlock island is part of a much larger universe... [1/2]
entries.translation: 你的 空岛 岛屿只是广阔世界的一部分…… [1/2]

entries.source: Could you find my dear Romero?
entries.translation: 能帮我找找我亲爱的 Romero 吗?

entries.source: He wears glasses and blends well in a crowd!
entries.translation: 他戴着眼镜，混在人群里很不起眼!
entries.sampleRaw: He wears glasses and blends well in a crowd!

entries.source: He's in a cave somewhere under the Savanna Woodland.
entries.translation: 他在热带草原林地下面的某个洞穴里。
entries.sampleRaw: He's in a cave somewhere under the §aSavanna Woodland§f.

entries.source: Between you and me, if you ever want to upgrade it you should travel to the Crimson Isle.
entries.translation: 私下告诉你,想升级的话,应该去绯红岛。

styleMappings.Between you and me, if you ever want to: 私下告诉你,想升级的话,应该去

entries.sampleRaw: §fBetween you and me, if you ever want to upgrade it you should travel to the §cCrimson Isle§f.

entries.source: A bouquet? For me? How sweet!
entries.translation: 一束花? 送我的? 太贴心了!

entries.source: A flower? For me? How sweet!
entries.translation: 一朵花? 送我的? 太贴心了!

entries.source: Hey there, I'm Kat the Pet Sitter!
entries.translation: 你好呀,我是宠物保姆 Kat!
entries.sampleRaw: §fHey there, I'm Kat the Pet Sitter!

entries.source: I might even be able to give them new abilities!
entries.translation: 我甚至还能赋予它们新的能力!
entries.sampleRaw: §fI might even be able to give them new abilities!

entries.source: If you have any other pets you'd like to upgrade, you know where to find me!
entries.translation: 还有别的宠物想升级的话,你知道上哪儿找我!
entries.sampleRaw: If you have any other pets you'd like to upgrade, you know where to find me!

entries.source: Stop by once it's done, okay?
entries.translation: 完成后记得回来一趟,好吗?
entries.sampleRaw: Stop by once it's done, okay?

entries.source: While you're busy adventuring I can take care of your pets.
entries.translation: 你忙着冒险时,我可以替你照顾宠物。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWhile you're busy adventuring I can take care of your pets.

entries.source: ✆ But hold on, I don't give my contact for everyone.
entries.translation: ✆ 不过等等,我可不是谁都给联系方式的。

styleMappings.But hold on, I don't give my contact for: 不过等等,我可不是谁都给联系方式的。

entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fBut hold on, I don't give my contact for everyone.

entries.source: ✆ Do you want me to train your pet?
entries.sampleRaw: §b✆ §fDo you want me to train your pet?

entries.translation: ✆ 交个朋友? 当然可以!

styleMappings.Friends? Sure!: 交个朋友? 当然可以!

entries.source: Excellent! You have returned the Scavenged Diamond Axe to its rightful place!
entries.translation: 太好了! 你把翻找到的钻石斧物归原主了!
entries.sampleRaw: Excellent! You have returned the §cScavenged Diamond Axe §rto its rightful place!

entries.source: Excellent! You have returned the Scavenged Emerald Hammer to its rightful place!
entries.translation: 太好了! 你把翻找到的绿宝石锤物归原主了!
entries.sampleRaw: Excellent! You have returned the §cScavenged Emerald Hammer §rto its rightful place!

entries.source: Excellent! You have returned the Scavenged Golden Hammer to its rightful place!
entries.translation: 太好了! 你把翻找到的金锤物归原主了!
entries.sampleRaw: Excellent! You have returned the §cScavenged Golden Hammer §rto its rightful place!

entries.source: Excellent! You have returned the Scavenged Lapis Sword to its rightful place!
entries.translation: 太好了! 你把翻找到的青金石剑物归原主了!
entries.sampleRaw: Excellent! You have returned the §cScavenged Lapis Sword §rto its rightful place!

entries.source: Talk to me when you have found a Scavenged Diamond Axe!
entries.translation: 带着翻找到的钻石斧再来找我吧!
entries.sampleRaw: Talk to me when you have found a §cScavenged Diamond Axe§r!

entries.source: Talk to me when you have found a Scavenged Emerald Hammer!
entries.translation: 带着翻找到的绿宝石锤再来找我吧!
entries.sampleRaw: Talk to me when you have found a §cScavenged Emerald Hammer§r!

entries.source: Talk to me when you have found a Scavenged Golden Hammer!
entries.translation: 带着翻找到的金锤再来找我吧!
entries.sampleRaw: Talk to me when you have found a §cScavenged Golden Hammer§r!

entries.source: Talk to me when you have found a Scavenged Lapis Sword!
entries.translation: 带着翻找到的青金石剑再来找我吧!
entries.sampleRaw: Talk to me when you have found a §cScavenged Lapis Sword§r!

entries.source: Sadly you can't gather logs in the The Garden, however there are plenty of crops here!
entries.translation: 可惜花园里没法采集原木,不过这里的庄稼倒是多得很!

styleMappings., however there are plenty of crops here: 里没法采集原木,不过这里的庄稼倒是多得很!

entries.sampleRaw: §fSadly you can't gather logs in the §aThe Garden§f, however there are plenty of crops here!

entries.source: Greetings! I've been running low on paper recently for my Enchanted Books, could you bring me some Sugar Cane?
entries.translation: 你好! 我最近做附魔书的纸快用完了,能给我带些甘蔗来吗?
entries.sampleRaw: §fGreetings! I've been running low on paper recently for my Enchanted Books, could you bring me some Sugar Cane?

entries.translation: 你好! 欢迎来到图书馆!

entries.source: I'll be sure to make some Enchanted Books out of these, I hope you come around some day!
entries.translation: 我一定用它们做出几本附魔书来,希望你哪天来坐坐!
entries.sampleRaw: §fI'll be sure to make some Enchanted Books out of these, I hope you come around some day!

entries.source: The Library is your one-stop shop for all things enchanting. Enchant items, purchase Enchanted Books, and more!
entries.translation: 图书馆能满足你的一切附魔需求:附魔物品、购买附魔书等等!

styleMappings.is your one-stop shop for all things enc: 能满足你的一切附魔需求:附魔物品、购买

entries.sampleRaw: §fThe §3Library §fis your one-stop shop for all things enchanting. Enchant items, purchase §aEnchanted Books§f, and more!

entries.source: Use the Enchantment Table to enchant an item!
entries.translation: 使用附魔台为物品附魔!

entries.source: Very unfortunate, I really needed that paper...
entries.translation: 真遗憾,我是真的很需要那些纸……

entries.source: You can enchant items by clicking any Enchantment Table. Enchanting costs experience levels - the more levels you spend, the better enchantments you will receive.
entries.translation: 点击任意附魔台即可为物品附魔。附魔会消耗经验等级——花费的等级越多,获得的附魔就越好。

styleMappings.. Enchanting costs: 即可为物品附魔。附魔会消耗
styleMappings.- the more levels you spend, the better: ——花费的等级越多,获得的附魔就越好。

entries.sampleRaw: §fYou can enchant items by clicking any §aEnchantment Table§f. Enchanting costs §3experience levels §f- the more levels you spend, the better enchantments you will receive.

entries.source: Sorry, but there's... not much to see here right now.
entries.translation: 抱歉,不过……现在这里没什么可看的。
entries.sampleRaw: Sorry, but there's... not much to see here right now.

entries.source: Ah you found my Dragon Shortbow!
entries.translation: 啊，你找到我的巨龙短弓了!

entries.source: Ah, do you need help finding the remaining pieces?
entries.translation: 啊,还差几件没找到? 要我帮忙吗?

entries.source: Ahh, this one is a bit tricky.
Anyways, I'm hurt and I lost my bow in the chaos.
entries.translation: 总之，我受了伤，混乱中还把弓给弄丢了。
entries.sampleRaw: Anyways, I'm hurt and I lost my bow in the chaos.

entries.source: Are there other pieces you need info on?
Are you sure you don't want that sword?

entries.translation: 有关巨龙的事，尽管问我!

entries.source: Awesome, wear all the pieces and show me!
entries.translation: 太好了,穿齐所有部件给我看看!

entries.source: But the truth is, I really like it here.
entries.translation: 可说真的，我还挺喜欢这里的。
entries.sampleRaw: But the truth is, I really like it here.

entries.source: Come see me later and I'll tell you all about them!
entries.translation: 晚点来找我，我给你好好讲讲它们!
entries.sampleRaw: Come see me later and I'll tell you all about them!

entries.source: Do you recognize me? I changed my armor!
entries.translation: 还认得我吗? 我换了身护甲!

entries.source: Drop by his shop a little later and I'm sure he will sell you one for cheap!
entries.translation: 过会儿去他店里看看吧，他肯定会便宜卖你一把!
entries.sampleRaw: Drop by his shop a little later and I'm sure he will sell you one for cheap!

entries.translation: 累了? 我? 不不不。

entries.source: For the longest time I thought I would move to the Crimson Isle or visit the Catacombs after this place.
entries.translation: 很长一段时间里，我都想着，离开这里以后就去绯红岛，或者到地牢看看。

styleMappings.For the longest time I thought I would m: 很长一段时间里，我都想着，离开这里以后就去

entries.sampleRaw: For the longest time I thought I would move to the §cCrimson Isle §ror visit the §7Catacombs §rafter this place.

entries.source: Half of them are dropped by the Endermen on this layer, the other pieces are a little harder to obtain.
entries.translation: 其中一半会由这一层的末影人掉落,其余几件就没那么容易找了。

entries.source: Happy dealing with you, I hope this sword will help you as much as it helped me.
entries.translation: 成交,合作愉快! 希望这把剑也能像当初帮我一样帮到你。

entries.source: Have you found the full Ender Armor Set and Equipment yet?
entries.translation: 你已经集齐整套末影护甲与装备了吗?

entries.source: He doesn't usually sell them but he's my friend.
entries.translation: 他平时不卖这个，不过我俩是朋友。
entries.sampleRaw: He doesn't usually sell them but he's my friend.

entries.source: I got the bow from the Pearl Dealer up there near the entrance of the island.
entries.translation: 这把弓是我从上面岛屿入口附近的珍珠商人那里弄来的。

styleMappings.I got the bow from the: 这把弓是我从上面岛屿入口附近的

entries.sampleRaw: I got the bow from the §5Pearl Dealer §rup there near the entrance of the island.

entries.source: I have an extremely strong emotional attachment to this item so...
entries.translation: 我对这把剑可是感情深厚,所以嘛……

entries.source: I knew I saw one of those Seers grab it for themselves.
entries.translation: 我就说没看错，果然是哪个先知把它顺走了。
entries.sampleRaw: I knew I saw one of those Seers grab it for themselves.

entries.source: I think you are making a mistake, perhaps the biggest mistake of your life!
entries.translation: 我觉得你这决定可不明智,说不定会后悔一辈子!

entries.source: I use a Void Sword, it's a very powerful weapon.
entries.translation: 我用的是虚空之剑,这武器可厉害了。
entries.sampleRaw: I use a §5Void Sword§r, it's a very powerful weapon.

entries.source: I'll let him know you helped me!
entries.translation: 我会告诉他，你可是帮了我大忙!
entries.sampleRaw: I'll let him know you helped me!

entries.source: I'm just about to go slay some Dragons.
entries.translation: 我正准备再去猎杀几头巨龙。

styleMappings.I'm just about to go slay some: 我正准备再去猎杀几头

entries.sampleRaw: I'm just about to go slay some §cDragons§r.

entries.source: I'm sure one of them will have my Dragon Shortbow.
entries.translation: 我的巨龙短弓肯定在它们其中一个手上。

肯定在它们其中一个手上。

entries.sampleRaw: I'm sure one of them will have my §5Dragon Shortbow§r.

entries.source: I'm sure you'll figure it out.
entries.translation: 我相信你会找到办法的。

entries.source: If you mine enough Ender Nodes you'll eventually find the Gauntlet.
entries.translation: 多挖一些末影节点,迟早能找到末影护手。

entries.source: If you take down enough of those you'll end up getting the Cloak.
entries.translation: 多击败一些,就能拿到末影披风。

entries.source: If you want a piece of advice, you should start by killing the Endermen up here.
entries.translation: 要我给点建议的话,你应该先练练手,去杀这上面的末影人。

styleMappings.If you want a piece of advice, you shoul: 要我给点建议的话,你应该先练练手,去杀这上面的

entries.sampleRaw: If you want a piece of advice, you should start by killing the §cEndermen §rup here.

entries.source: It gets stronger with each piece of Ender Armor you are wearing.
entries.translation: 你身上的末影护甲每多一件,它的威力就更强一分。

每多一件,它的威力就更强一分。

entries.sampleRaw: It gets stronger with each piece of §5Ender Armor §ryou are wearing.

entries.source: It took me a while to get that strong.
entries.translation: 我当初可是练了好一阵才有这身手。
entries.sampleRaw: §fIt took me a while to get that strong.

entries.source: It's from those Endermen up there, where we first met.
entries.translation: 它是从上面那些末影人身上掉的,就是我们第一次见面的地方。

身上掉的,就是我们第一次见面的地方。

entries.source: It's just from regular Endermen, like the rest of the armor!
entries.translation: 它和其他护甲一样,普通末影人就会掉!

styleMappings.It's just from regular: 它和其他护甲一样,普通

entries.source: My time here is over, I think I'll go down in the Dragon's Nest very soon.
entries.translation: 我在这儿待得差不多了,应该很快就会下到龙巢去。

styleMappings.My time here is over, I think I'll go do: 我在这儿待得差不多了,应该很快就会下到

entries.sampleRaw: My time here is over, I think I'll go down in the §5Dragon's Nest §rvery soon.

entries.source: Okay. If you need help, I'll be here.
entries.translation: 行,需要帮忙的话,我就在这儿。

entries.source: Thank you so much, I owe you one.
entries.translation: 太感谢了，算我欠你个人情。
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you so much, I owe you one.

entries.source: That was crazy, I'm still shaking!
entries.translation: 太吓人了，我到现在还在发抖!
entries.sampleRaw: That was crazy, I'm still shaking!

entries.source: That's incredible, that took me at least a week!
entries.translation: 真厉害! 我当初可花了至少一个星期呢!
entries.sampleRaw: That's incredible, that took me at least a week!

entries.source: The Dragon teleported behind me and hit me with a claw attack!
entries.translation: 那头龙突然传送到我背后，一爪子就拍了过来!
entries.sampleRaw: The Dragon teleported behind me and hit me with a claw attack!

entries.source: The End is a creepy place, but you get used to it!
entries.translation: 末地是有点瘆人,不过待久了就习惯了!

styleMappings.is a creepy place, but you get used to i: 是有点瘆人,不过待久了就习惯了!

entries.sampleRaw: §5The End §ris a creepy place, but you get used to it!

entries.source: The fight was going smoothly and just as I was about to land the finishing blow, BAM!
entries.translation: 本来打得好好的，眼看就要给它最后一击了——砰!

styleMappings.The fight was going smoothly and just as: 本来打得好好的，眼看就要给它最后一击了——

entries.sampleRaw: The fight was going smoothly and just as I was about to land the finishing blow, §cBAM§r!

entries.source: They sometimes drop important gear like the armor I'm wearing.
entries.translation: 它们有时会掉落很有用的装备,比如我身上这套护甲。

styleMappings.They sometimes drop important gear like: 它们有时会掉落很有用的装备,比如我身上这套

entries.sampleRaw: They sometimes drop important gear like the §aarmor §rI'm wearing.

entries.source: What I enjoyed the most was helping you and I want to stay here to help more people.
entries.translation: 帮上你的忙，是我最开心的事。所以我想留下来，再帮帮其他人。
entries.sampleRaw: What I enjoyed the most was helping you and I want to stay here to help more people.

entries.source: Which piece are you struggling to find?
Woah, you're wearing the full Ender Set!
entries.translation: 哇，你已经穿齐整套末影套装了!
entries.sampleRaw: Woah, you're wearing the full Ender Set!

entries.source: Would you mind defeating some of them for me?
entries.translation: 能帮我去打倒一些先知吗?
entries.sampleRaw: Would you mind defeating some of them for me?

entries.source: You already made a ton of progress and I'm excited for the future.
entries.translation: 你已经进步这么多了，真期待你接下来的冒险。
entries.sampleRaw: You already made a ton of progress and I'm excited for the future.

entries.translation: 你这反应，好像没多激动啊……

entries.source: You haven't got this one yet?
You see those Seers inside the Dragon's Nest?
entries.translation: 看到龙巢里的那些先知了吗?

entries.source: You see those purple End Stone or Obsidian that sometimes appear around here?
entries.translation: 看到附近偶尔出现的那些紫色末地石或黑曜石了吗?

entries.source: You wouldn't believe what just happened, I was fighting one of those Dragons...
entries.translation: 你绝对想不到刚才发生了什么，我正跟一头巨龙交战……

styleMappings.You wouldn't believe what just happened,: 你绝对想不到刚才发生了什么，我正跟一头

entries.sampleRaw: You wouldn't believe what just happened, I was fighting one of those §5Dragons§r...

entries.source: ⚑ Dragon Guide is my new vocation.
entries.translation: ⚑ 巨龙向导就是我的新工作。

entries.source: Buy a few items from Sirius and come back!
entries.translation: 去买几件物品吧,从Sirius那儿买完再回来!

entries.source: He regularly runs events at a nearby house, but only under the cover of night.
entries.translation: 他经常趁夜色掩护在附近的一栋房子里举办活动。

styleMappings.runs events at a nearby house, but only: 趁夜色掩护在附近的一栋房子里举办活动。

entries.sampleRaw: §fHe §f§oregularly §fruns events at a nearby house, but only under the cover of night.

entries.source: It's a... business, auctioning sweet items.
entries.translation: 那是个……做好货拍卖的生意。

entries.source: My cousin Sirius leads an... organization.
entries.translation: 我的表亲Sirius领导着一个……组织。

entries.source: As you do this, you'll unlock various crafts and useful stat boosts that will help in other areas of your adventure.
entries.translation: 在这个过程中,你会解锁各种配方和实用的属性加成,它们也会在冒险的其他方面助你一臂之力。
entries.sampleRaw: As you do this, you'll unlock various crafts and useful stat boosts that will help in other areas of your adventure.

entries.source: Cheers! Let me tell ya a little about what we're going to be doing.
entries.translation: 太好了! 让我简单说说我们接下来要做什么。
entries.sampleRaw: Cheers! Let me tell ya a little about what we're going to be doing.

entries.source: Have you enchanted your axe with Efficiency V? It'll help ya break stuff a lot faster.
entries.translation: 你给斧头附魔效率 V 了吗? 它能让你破坏东西快得多。

styleMappings.? It'll help ya break stuff a lot faster: 了吗? 它能让你破坏东西快得多。

entries.source: Have you spoken to my mate Charlie over in The Park yet? He could probably use your help.

entries.translation: 现在你有了山峦之心,矿山更深处的区域都对你开放了!

styleMappings., you have access to all of the deeper a: ,矿山更深处的区域都对你开放了!

entries.sampleRaw: §fNow that you have your §5Heart of the Mountain§r, you have access to all of the deeper areas of the mines!

entries.source: Perhaps you are someone we can get along with after all.
entries.translation: 看来你也许是个能相处得来的人。
entries.sampleRaw: §fPerhaps you are someone we can get along with after all.

entries.source: So you want to visit the Dwarven Mines?
entries.sampleRaw: §fSo you want to visit the §2Dwarven Mines§f?

entries.translation: 谢谢你带来的这些东西!
谢谢你! 新发现在等着我们呢。

entries.source: That's not an item I'm looking for!
entries.sampleRaw: §fThat's not an item I'm looking for!

entries.source: We Dwarves inhabit this area. We love it! It is rich in Mithril and even some Titanium.
entries.translation: 我们矮人就住在这一带。我们爱这儿! 这里秘银储量丰富,甚至还有一些钛。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWe Dwarves inhabit this area. We love it! It is rich in Mithril and even some Titanium.

entries.source: Well then, I will even mine in total darkness if I must!
entries.translation: 那好吧,就算全黑我也照样挖!
entries.sampleRaw: §fWell then, I will even mine in total darkness if I must!

entries.source: You are no match for the Dwarves of the Dwarven Mines.
entries.translation: 你还不是矮人矿山中那些矮人的对手。
entries.sampleRaw: You are no match for the Dwarves of the §2Dwarven Mines§f.

entries.source: You can access the Heart of the Mountain from the Mining Skill menu, and unlock loads of powerful upgrades as you continue your journey!
entries.translation: 你可以从挖矿技能菜单里打开山峦之心,随着旅程推进解锁大量强力升级!

styleMappings.You can access the: 你可以从挖矿技能菜单里打开
styleMappings.from the Mining Skill menu, and unlock l: ,随着旅程推进解锁大量强力升级!

entries.sampleRaw: §fYou can access the §5Heart of the Mountain §rfrom the Mining Skill menu, and unlock loads of powerful upgrades as you continue your journey!

entries.source: You can ask the Lift Operator for a ride to the Dwarven Mines!
entries.translation: 你可以找升降梯管理员捎你去矮人矿山!
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou can ask the §bLift Operator §ffor a ride to the §2Dwarven Mines§f!

entries.source: You must bring me some valuable materials that peak my interest.
entries.translation: 你得给我带些能让我提得起兴趣的贵重材料来。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou must bring me some valuable materials that peak my interest.

entries.source: You must prove yourself worthy of Heart of the Mountain...
entries.translation: 你得先证明自己配得上山峦之心才行……

styleMappings.You must prove yourself worthy of: 你得先证明自己配得上

entries.sampleRaw: §fYou must prove yourself worthy of §5Heart of the Mountain§f...

entries.source: You will need a good pickaxe to mine ores here. For Mithril, at least something with a Breaking Power of 4. Bubu just down the street could help you with that!
entries.translation: 要在这儿挖矿石,你得有把好镐子。想挖秘银,至少也得有开采等级 4 级的家伙。街那头的Bubu就能帮你弄到!

styleMappings.You will need a good pickaxe to mine ore: 要在这儿挖矿石,你得有把好镐子。想挖秘银,至少也得有

entries.sampleRaw: §fYou will need a good pickaxe to mine ores here. For Mithril, at least something with a §aBreaking Power §rof 4. §5Bubu §rjust down the street could help you with that!

entries.source: Whatever. Go talk to Liz, she'll tell you what's up.
entries.translation: 随便吧。去找Liz,她会告诉你怎么回事。
entries.sampleRaw: Whatever. Go talk to §aLiz§f, she'll tell you what's up.

entries.source: One of us is telling the truth!
entries.translation: 我们之中有一个人说的是真话!
entries.sampleRaw: One of us is telling the truth!

entries.source: The reward is not in my chest. They are both lying.
entries.translation: 奖励不在我的箱子里。他们俩都在说谎。
entries.sampleRaw: The reward is not in my chest. They are both lying.

entries.source: Don't know what equipment to aim for?
entries.translation: 不知道该以什么装备为目标?
entries.sampleRaw: §fDon't know what equipment to aim for?

entries.source: Try some of my starter gear!
Behold a fellow holder of Heart of the Mountain!
entries.translation: 瞧啊,又一位持有山峦之心的同道!
entries.sampleRaw: §fBehold a fellow holder of Heart of the Mountain!

entries.source: Great treasures lie ahead, but at what cost?
entries.translation: 前方有无尽的宝藏,可代价又是什么呢?
entries.sampleRaw: §fGreat treasures lie ahead, but at what cost?

entries.source: There are no miners like the dwarves.
entries.translation: 论挖矿,没人比得上矮人。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThere are no miners like the dwarves.

entries.source: Watch yourself, traveler. There are creatures about.
entries.translation: 当心点,旅人。这附近有东西在游荡。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWatch yourself, traveler. There are creatures about.

entries.source: Hi, I'm the janitor of this mine.
entries.translation: 你好,我是这座矿井的清洁工。
entries.sampleRaw: Hi, I'm the janitor of this mine.

entries.source: I'll have to put it in my stores.
entries.sampleRaw: §fI'll have to put it in my stores.

entries.source: It drives me insane, but at least you unlocked Auto-pickup.
entries.translation: 这简直让我抓狂,不过好在你已经解锁了自动拾取。

styleMappings.It drives me insane, but at least you un: 这简直让我抓狂,不过好在你已经解锁了

entries.sampleRaw: It drives me insane, but at least you unlocked §aAuto-pickup§r.

entries.source: It makes my job a lot easier, but despite that, I still find so many items on the ground.
entries.translation: 这让我的工作轻松了许多,可即便如此,我还是会在地上发现许多物品。
entries.sampleRaw: It makes my job a lot easier, but despite that, I still find so many items on the ground.

entries.source: Maybe some of those items are yours? In which case I'll let you buy them back.
entries.translation: 也许其中有些就是你的? 如果真是这样,我可以让你把它们买回去。
entries.sampleRaw: Maybe some of those items are yours? In which case I'll let you buy them back.

entries.source: You found the Lazy Miner's pickaxe!
entries.translation: 你找到了懒惰矿工的镐子!

entries.source: You would not believe how many people leave ingots and stones behind them!
entries.translation: 你绝对想不到有多少人会把锭块和石头落在这里!
entries.sampleRaw: You would not believe how many people leave ingots and stones behind them!

entries.source: Did you know that there is a Garden Level? Increase it by hitting milestones or selling to customers like me!
entries.translation: 你知道花园还有等级吗? 达成里程碑,或者把东西卖给我这样的顾客,等级就能往上涨!
entries.sampleRaw: §fDid you know that there is a Garden Level? Increase it by hitting milestones or selling to customers like me!

entries.source: Thank you for supporting the server and allowing us to maintain SkyBlock!
entries.translation: 谢谢你支持服务器,让我们能继续维护 空岛!
entries.sampleRaw: Thank you for supporting the server and allowing us to maintain SkyBlock!

entries.source: Alright, I feel better now. First we need to gather some resources to build the Greenhouse.
entries.translation: 好了,我缓过来了。首先,咱们得凑齐建温室的材料。

entries.source: Amazing! We've done it! Our very first harvest from the Greenhouse. You've really got the hang of this.
entries.translation: 太棒了! 成功了! 温室里的第一次收成。你已经完全上手了。

entries.source: Amazing!!! We got ourselves a brand new plot!
entries.translation: 太棒了!!! 咱们有一块崭新的地啦!
entries.sampleRaw: Amazing!!! We got ourselves a brand new plot!

entries.source: Amazing!!! We got ourselves a brand new plot!!
entries.translation: 太棒了!!! 咱们有一块崭新的地啦!

entries.source: And don't forget to water them!
As your Garden Level increases from working on the farm, you'll be able to harvest more crops. Amazing!
entries.translation: 在农场里忙活能提升花园等级,等级越高,能种的作物就越多。太棒了!

entries.source: Besides that, you can always go check the desk to find out what to do next!
entries.translation: 另外,不知道接下来做什么的话,随时可以去管理台看看!
entries.sampleRaw: Besides that, you can always go check the desk to find out what to do next!

entries.source: Come and talk to me when you've finished up on your Plot!
entries.translation: 你那块地忙完了就来找我聊聊!
entries.sampleRaw: Come and talk to me when you've finished up on your Plot!

entries.source: Could you help me out with my farm?
Do you know what this means??
entries.translation: 你知道这意味着什么吗??

entries.source: Don't be selfish! This Wheat is too good to waste. We've got enough to share with everyone!
entries.translation: 别这么小气嘛! 这么好的小麦浪费了多可惜。咱们多得很,够分给大家的!
entries.sampleRaw: Don't be selfish! This Wheat is too good to waste. We've got enough to share with everyone!

entries.source: Excuse my manners, my name is Sam and I live next door... or should I rather say next "island".
entries.translation: 请原谅我没先自我介绍,我叫 Sam,就住在隔壁……或者该说隔壁的“岛”上。

entries.source: For that however... I need some Compost... If you can bring me some Wheat, I can make some Compost out of it!
entries.translation: 不过要清地……得先有堆肥……你要是能给我弄些小麦来,我就能拿它做出堆肥!
entries.sampleRaw: §fFor that however... I need some Compost... If you can bring me some Wheat, I can make some Compost out of it!

entries.source: From what I remember, all you need to do is plant 2x Seeds side by side. Make sure to leave space for the mutation to spread!
entries.translation: 我记得,只要把 2 份种子并排种下就行。记得留出空位,好让变异作物长出来!

styleMappings.side by side. Make sure to leave space f: 并排种下就行。记得留出空位,好让

entries.sampleRaw: §fFrom what I remember, all you need to do is plant §e2x Seeds §fside by side. Make sure to leave space for the §cmutation§f to spread!

entries.source: From what I remember, all you need to do is surround an empty piece of farmland with 4x Wheat Crops, in a plus shape!
entries.translation: 我记得,只要用 4 株小麦把一格空耕地围成十字形就行!

entries.source: Go ahead and harvest the mutated crop. Right there, in the middle of the wheat!
entries.translation: 去把那株变异作物收了吧。就在那儿,小麦中间!

entries.source: Go ahead and talk to them to see what they need!
entries.translation: 去跟对方聊聊,看看需要什么!

entries.source: Great job! I think you are ready to learn about mutations now!
entries.translation: 干得漂亮! 我看你可以学学变异作物了!

entries.source: Great! Now, you can go open the composter and put the fuel in there, and it'll start doing... whatever it does!
entries.translation: 太好了! 现在去打开堆肥器,把燃料放进去,它就会开始……嗯,干它该干的事!
entries.sampleRaw: §fGreat! Now, you can go open the composter and put the fuel in there, and it'll start doing... whatever it does!

entries.source: Have you refuelled the Composter yet?
entries.translation: 你给堆肥器加燃料了吗?

entries.source: He was a very skillful farmer... not like me... I have two left thumbs when it comes to farming.
entries.translation: 他曾是个非常熟练的农夫……不像我……我干起农活来总是笨手笨脚。

entries.source: Head over to your unlocked plot and try to clean it up a bit and then come back to me once you've done so!
entries.translation: 去你刚解锁的那块地,把它收拾收拾,弄完了再回来找我!
entries.sampleRaw: Head over to your unlocked plot and try to clean it up a bit and then come back to me once you've done so!

entries.source: Hmmm, it seems we can't go to The Garden right now. Let's try again later...
entries.translation: 嗯……现在好像去不了花园。待会儿再试试吧……

entries.source: Hmmmm I think that's right. I watered them too so they grow strong and healthy!
entries.translation: 嗯……我觉得这样就对了。我也给它们浇过水了,保准长得壮壮的!

entries.source: However, it looks like one of your co-op members already did that!
entries.translation: 不过,看起来你的合作伙伴已经把这事办好了!

entries.source: I am so excited to have you here!
entries.translation: 你能来我真是太开心了!
entries.sampleRaw: §fI am so excited to have you here!

entries.source: I believe in you. Go make it sparkly clean!
entries.translation: 我相信你。去把它收拾得亮堂堂的!
entries.sampleRaw: I believe in you. Go make it sparkly clean!

entries.source: I have a few seeds left for you to try it out for yourself!
entries.translation: 我还剩几份种子,给你自己试试!

entries.source: I have an idea! Why don't you collect me some Wheat and I'll bake us some lovely bread for dinner!
entries.translation: 我有个主意! 你去给我收点小麦,我来烤几块香喷喷的面包当晚饭!
entries.sampleRaw: I have an idea! Why don't you collect me some Wheat and I'll bake us some lovely bread for dinner!

entries.source: I love spring! It's not too hot or too cold, it's perfect!
entries.translation: 我最爱春天了! 不冷不热,刚刚好!

entries.source: I should go out with my friends soon, maybe get some ice cream.
entries.translation: 我该找朋友们出去玩玩了,顺便吃个冰淇淋。
entries.sampleRaw: I should go out with my friends soon, maybe get some ice cream.

entries.source: I taught you all I know about Greenhouses, you are on your own from now on!
entries.translation: 关于温室我知道的都教给你了,接下来就靠你自己啦!

styleMappings., you are on your own from now on!: 我知道的都教给你了,接下来就靠你自己啦!

entries.sampleRaw: §fI taught you all I know about §aGreenhouses§f, you are on your own from now on!

entries.source: I think this spot would work perfectly!
entries.translation: 我看这个位置就再合适不过了!
entries.sampleRaw: §fI think this spot would work perfectly!

entries.source: I was wondering if maybe you could... help me out... with my farm.
entries.translation: 我在想,也许你能……帮帮我……打理农场。

entries.source: I'll make sure to find a nice place for it!
entries.translation: 我一定给它找个好地方摆着!

entries.source: I'm so excited, I can't wait to get started on it!
entries.translation: 太激动了,我等不及要动工了!

entries.source: I'm sorry, I just can't help myself. Let me calm myself down a bit.
entries.translation: 抱歉,我实在按捺不住。让我先冷静一下。

entries.source: If you can find these items, we'll be one step closer to building our very own Greenhouse!
entries.translation: 只要你能找齐这些东西,咱们离自己的温室就更近一步了!

entries.source: If you have any more questions, you can talk to the Carpenter in the Greenhouse.
entries.translation: 还有什么问题的话,可以去温室里找木匠聊聊。

styleMappings.If you have any more questions, you can: 还有什么问题的话,可以去

entries.sampleRaw: §fIf you have any more questions, you can talk to the Carpenter in the §aGreenhouse§f.

entries.source: In here, you need to water crops from time to time to keep them healthy.
entries.translation: 在这里,你得时不时浇一浇,作物才能长得健康。

entries.source: Inside the Greenhouse, crops usually grow at a much slower speed than normal, but they will also yield way more!
entries.translation: 温室里的作物长得比平时慢得多,但产量也高得多!

entries.source: It looks like one of your co-op members already purchased a plot, but you should go help them clean it up!
entries.translation: 看来你的合作伙伴已经买下一块地了,不过你也该去搭把手,一起清理!

entries.source: It needs machine fuel to operate... luckily we can order fuel online!
entries.translation: 它得靠机器燃料才能运转……好在燃料可以直接网购!
entries.sampleRaw: §fIt needs machine fuel to operate... luckily we can order fuel online!

entries.source: It produces Compost when you put crops inside of it... somehow... but that's what I need to increase the amount of plots we can have! So exciting!
entries.translation: 把庄稼丢进去,它就能产出堆肥……原理我也说不清……但有了堆肥,咱们能开的地皮数量就能变多! 想想就激动!

styleMappings.It produces Compost when you put crops i: 把庄稼丢进去,它就能产出堆肥……原理我也说不清……但有了堆肥,咱们能开的
styleMappings.we can have! So exciting!: 就能变多! 想想就激动!

entries.sampleRaw: §fIt produces Compost when you put crops inside of it... somehow... but that's what I need to increase the §f§lamount of plots §fwe can have! So exciting!

entries.source: It's also great for knowing when a crop will finish growing or how much water it needs!
entries.translation: 它还能告诉你作物什么时候长熟、还需要多少水!

entries.source: It's fully grown! You should be able to harvest it now.
entries.translation: 长熟了! 现在可以收获了。

entries.source: It's pretty tasty. But it seems like we still have some dozen Wheat left over and our Composter is already full...
entries.translation: 真好吃。不过好像还剩下几十个小麦,而堆肥器已经装满了……
entries.sampleRaw: It's pretty tasty. But it seems like we still have some dozen Wheat left over and our Composter is already full...

entries.source: Just aim the can at the crop you want to water and hold right-click!
entries.translation: 把洒水壶对准想浇的作物,按住右键就行!

entries.source: Keep checking back on them, I am sure more people will visit our farm soon.
entries.translation: 记得常回来看看,我敢说很快就会有更多人来咱们农场的。
entries.sampleRaw: Keep checking back on them, I am sure more people will visit our farm soon.

entries.source: Look at that! It's already growing! It should be ready to harvest soon.
entries.translation: 快看! 它已经在长了! 应该很快就能收获。

entries.source: Looking at the blueprint, it seems we need about 64 Enchanted Oak Logs and ...? 128 Enchanted Sand??
entries.translation: 照设计图看,大概需要 64 个附魔橡木原木,还有……? 128 个附魔沙子??

entries.source: Make sure you're keeping yourself warm.
Make sure your composter has enough resources! It won't start making more compost if it doesn't have the full materials to do it.
entries.translation: 记得给堆肥器备足材料! 材料不够的话,它是不会开工做堆肥的。
entries.sampleRaw: Make sure your composter has enough resources! It won't start making more compost if it doesn't have the full materials to do it.

entries.source: Meet me on your own island for help.
entries.translation: 想找我帮忙的话,回你自己的岛上来见我。

entries.source: Nice! But crops need water to grow. Use this watering can to water the plot.
entries.translation: 不错! 但作物得浇水才能生长。用这把洒水壶给地皮浇浇水。

entries.source: Nice! Now that both plants are growing, take this Plant Diagnostics Tool to learn how crops are affected by each other.
entries.translation: 不错! 两株都在长了,拿上这个植物诊断工具,看看作物之间是怎么互相影响的。

entries.source: Now I can finally produce some Compost... let's head inside!
entries.translation: 这下总算能做堆肥了……咱们进屋去!
entries.sampleRaw: §fNow I can finally produce some Compost... let's head inside!

entries.source: Now that you are familiar with the basics, let's move on to the more advanced techniques.
entries.translation: 基础你已经熟悉了,接下来讲点进阶的技巧。

entries.source: Now to the dirty part... the plot has to be cleaned up before it can be used...
entries.translation: 接下来是脏活……这块地得先清理干净才能用……
entries.sampleRaw: Now to the dirty part... the plot has to be cleaned up before it can be used...

entries.source: Now you can grow crops you've unlocked there!
entries.translation: 现在你可以在那儿种已解锁的作物了!
entries.sampleRaw: Now you can grow crops you've unlocked there!

entries.source: Now, let's get to work. It's time to plant our first crop.
entries.translation: 好了,开工吧。该种下咱们的第一株作物了。

entries.source: Oh wow, is that gift for me?
entries.translation: 哇,这是送给我的礼物吗?

entries.source: Oh, I have an idea! We could open a small stand and sell our Wheat to other people!
entries.translation: 哦,我有主意了! 咱们可以支个小摊,把小麦卖给别人!
entries.sampleRaw: Oh, I have an idea! We could open a small stand and sell our Wheat to other people!

entries.source: Oh, I think you forgot to take this!
Oh, have you met my friends here? They like to host farming contests and sell cool new tools!
entries.translation: 哦,见过我这儿的朋友们了吗? 他们喜欢办农业竞赛,还卖各种新奇的工具!

entries.source: Oh, we already have our first customer! How exciting, I wonder what they want! Can you check on them?
entries.translation: 哦,第一位顾客已经上门了! 好激动,不知道对方想要什么! 你去招呼一下?
entries.sampleRaw: Oh, we already have our first customer! How exciting, I wonder what they want! Can you check on them?

entries.source: Once you do that, I'll show you a neat trick!
entries.translation: 弄好之后,我教你一个小妙招!
不然它们会彻底干枯的!

entries.source: Planted crops in your Greenhouse apply buffs and debuffs to nearby crops!
entries.translation: 温室里种下的作物会给旁边的作物施加增益或减益!

entries.source: Remember, you can order fuel from the Desk nearby.
entries.translation: 记得,燃料可以在旁边的管理台下单。

entries.source: Remember, you need to plant 2 Wheat crops next to each other.
entries.translation: 记住,要把 2 株小麦并排种下。

entries.source: Remember, you should go to the Desk and select one of your plots.
entries.translation: 记得去管理台,选一块你的地。

entries.source: Sometimes, when you grow certain crops next to each other, a mutation will eventually sprout nearby. This doesn't always need to be on dirt!
entries.translation: 有时候,把某些作物挨着种,附近就会冒出一株变异作物。而且它不一定非得长在泥土上!

entries.source: Take these Carrot x2 and plant them next to each other in the Greenhouse.
entries.translation: 拿上这 2 根胡萝卜,把它们并排种进温室。

entries.source: That shouldn't be a problem for someone like you, right?
entries.translation: 对你这样的人来说,不成问题吧?
entries.sampleRaw: That shouldn't be a problem for someone like you, right?

entries.translation: 树叶五颜六色的,真好看!

entries.source: Then, water them so they grow strong and healthy.
entries.translation: 然后给它们浇水,让它们长得壮壮的。

entries.source: Then, you should convert it to a Greenhouse.
There are lots of mutations that exist and they are quite interesting to discover, however I really only know how to spread one of them.
entries.translation: 变异作物有很多种,一一发现它们很有意思,不过我只知道其中一种的培育方法。

entries.source: This Scythe will help you clean your plot even faster!
entries.translation: 有了这把镰刀,清地能快不少!
entries.sampleRaw: This Scythe will help you clean your plot even faster!

entries.source: To bake us some bread, I think I need about 100 Wheat.
entries.translation: 要烤面包的话,我估计得要 100 个小麦。
entries.sampleRaw: To bake us some bread, I think I need about 100 Wheat.

entries.source: To save you a bit of time, you can also use a preset farm at your desk!
entries.translation: 想省点时间的话,也可以在管理台用预设农田!
entries.sampleRaw: To save you a bit of time, you can also use a preset farm at your desk!

entries.source: Try to use the Plant Diagnostics Tool on a crop to understand it better!
entries.translation: 对着作物用一下植物诊断工具,更好地了解它!

entries.source: Watering a crop inside the Greenhouse is different than normal.
entries.translation: 在温室里浇水和平时不一样。

entries.source: We can build our very own Greenhouse!
entries.translation: 咱们可以建一座属于自己的温室了!

entries.source: We can finally free up a plot! Take out the compost when you are ready!
entries.translation: 终于能腾出一块地了! 准备好了就把堆肥取出来吧!
entries.sampleRaw: We can finally free up a plot! Take out the compost when you are ready!

entries.source: We need to set up a stand somewhere...
entries.translation: 咱们得找个地方支摊子……
entries.sampleRaw: We need to set up a stand somewhere...

entries.source: What's this? ... A blueprint for a Greenhouse?!
entries.translation: 这是什么? ……温室的设计图?!

entries.source: When you paste a crop preset onto your Plot, it will plant any specified resource from your inventory. So cool!
entries.translation: 往地皮上粘贴作物预设时,它会自动从你背包里取材料种下去。太酷了!

entries.source: Why don't you do the honor? Here, take this carrot and plant it in the Greenhouse!
entries.translation: 这份荣誉就交给你了! 来,拿着这根胡萝卜,把它种进温室!

entries.source: Why don't you try it out right now?
Wow we did it! We served our first customer!
entries.translation: 哇,成功了! 咱们接待了第一位顾客!
entries.sampleRaw: Wow we did it! We served our first customer!

entries.source: Wow! It's squeaky clean over there, you did so well!
entries.translation: 哇! 那边收拾得一尘不染,你太厉害了!
entries.sampleRaw: Wow! It's squeaky clean over there, you did so well!

entries.source: Wow!! Thank you so much. I'll bring you right there.
entries.translation: 哇!! 太感谢你了。我这就带你过去。
entries.sampleRaw: Wow!! Thank you so much. I'll bring you right there.

entries.source: Wow, it looks even better than I imagined!
entries.translation: 哇,比我想象中还要漂亮!

entries.source: Wow, that was quick! Here, take some fresh bread! *nom* *nom*
entries.translation: 哇,这么快! 来,尝尝刚出炉的面包! *吧唧* *吧唧*
entries.sampleRaw: Wow, that was quick! Here, take some fresh bread! *nom* *nom*

entries.source: You are pretty much a Greenhouse Expert now!
entries.translation: 现在你差不多算温室专家了!

entries.source: You can come to me anytime you need help, but first let's clear out a plot to grow your crops.
entries.translation: 需要帮忙随时来找我,不过咱们得先清出一块地来种庄稼。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou can come to me anytime you need help, but first let's clear out a plot to grow your crops.

entries.source: You see, I've been having quite the struggle with my farm that I inherited from my father.
entries.translation: 你看,我一直不太会打理父亲留给我的农场。

entries.source: You seem to have quite a talent for growing crops... which is something I couldn't really say about myself...
entries.translation: 看来你很有种植作物的天赋……我自己可完全谈不上……

entries.source: Your first customer is right in front of you!
entries.translation: 你的第一位顾客就在你眼前!

entries.source: Thank you for joining the Safety Squad.
entries.sampleRaw: §fThank you for joining the Safety Squad.

entries.source: *sigh* You're missing out on some awfully fancy gear.
entries.translation: *叹气* 你错过了一些相当华丽的装备。

entries.source: Wanting to buy something from me? I got some pretty fancy tuxedos for sale, for a price of a small fortune.
entries.translation: 想买点什么? 我这儿有几套相当气派的燕尾服,就是得花上一小笔身家。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWanting to buy something from me? I got some pretty fancy tuxedos for sale, for a price of a small fortune.

entries.source: Wow, don't you look dashing with that! Pleasure doing business with you.
entries.translation: 哎呀,这身穿在你身上真精神! 合作愉快。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWow, don't you look dashing with that! Pleasure doing business with you.

entries.source: It seems like my brew selection is rather small...I've recently heard that melon juice is really sought after so maybe it can enhance my drinks' flavors!
entries.translation: 我这儿的酿饮种类好像是有点少……最近听说西瓜汁特别抢手,没准加进去能让我的饮品更好喝!
entries.sampleRaw: §fIt seems like my brew selection is rather small...I've recently heard that melon juice is really sought after so maybe it can enhance my drinks' flavors!

entries.source: Well done! I'm sure that even Sirius will enjoy my revolutionary melon refreshments.
entries.translation: 干得漂亮! 我这款全新西瓜特饮,就连 Sirius 喝了肯定都说好。
entries.sampleRaw: §fWell done! I'm sure that even Sirius will enjoy my revolutionary melon refreshments.

entries.source: What a pity! Enjoy the Bartender's terrible and unrefreshing mixins.
entries.translation: 真可惜! 好好享受 Bartender 那难喝又不解渴的混饮吧。

entries.source: Here are some helpful support articles that will help you keep your account more secure and avoid losing valuable progress or items.
entries.translation: 下面这几篇帮助文档能教你把账号护得更牢，别让辛苦攒下的进度和物品打了水漂。
entries.sampleRaw: Here are some helpful support articles that will help you keep your account more secure and avoid losing valuable progress or items.

entries.source: What a pleasant surprise! I see you have quite an impressive island.
entries.translation: 真是个惊喜! 看得出来,你的岛屿相当不错。
出门在外要注意安全,新兵!

entries.source: Amazing! Thanks for taking the time! Now, time to finish my Cactus Trap...and hopefully it boosts my pelt earnings.
entries.translation: 太好了! 谢谢你专门跑这一趟! 该去把我的仙人掌陷阱做完了……希望能多赚点毛皮。
entries.sampleRaw: §fAmazing! Thanks for taking the time! Now, time to finish my Cactus Trap...and hopefully it boosts my pelt earnings.

entries.source: I've been planning to build a trap for unaware animals so I can hunt them more efficiently. I really need some cactus, preferably the ones with the biggest spikes!
entries.translation: 我打算做个陷阱,趁动物没防备时逮住它们,打猎也能省点事。正缺些仙人掌,最好挑刺最大的!
entries.sampleRaw: §fI've been planning to build a trap for unaware animals so I can hunt them more efficiently. I really need some cactus, preferably the ones with the biggest spikes!

entries.source: You can't tell me that you couldn't find a single cactus...
entries.translation: 你可别告诉我,你连一株仙人掌都找不到……
来看看我这里的外观商品吧!

entries.source: Want to stand out while you slash and dash?
entries.translation: 想在挥剑冲锋时也能脱颖而出吗?
entries.sampleRaw: §fWant to §astand out §fwhile you slash and dash?

entries.source: You look like someone who values fashion as much as fighting!
entries.translation: 看样子,你和我一样,既重视战斗,也讲究时尚!

styleMappings.You look like someone who values: 看样子,你和我一样,既重视战斗,也讲究

entries.sampleRaw: §fYou look like someone who values §afashion §fas much as fighting!

entries.source: Do you have any more questions?
entries.sampleRaw: Do you have any more questions?

entries.source: In fact I'm the exact opposite of you....
entries.sampleRaw: §fIn fact I'm the exact opposite of you....

entries.source: I'll keep crunching on those ice cubes, maybe I am missing something.
entries.translation: 那我接着嚼我的冰块吧,说不定是我漏了什么门道。

entries.source: You are saying I need to combine these items with ice to have a taste? I'll believe it when I see it!
entries.translation: 你是说把这些东西和冰掺在一起就有味道了? 眼见为实,我得亲自试试!
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou are saying I need to combine these items with ice to have a taste? I'll believe it when I see it!

entries.source: The Hex does not have time for you.
entries.sampleRaw: §dThe Hex §fdoes not have time for you.

entries.source: The Hex does not wish to be tainted with useless items.
entries.translation: 海克斯不愿被无用物品玷污。
entries.sampleRaw: §dThe Hex §fdoes not wish to be tainted with §duseless §fitems.

entries.source: The Hex is troubled by your presence.
entries.translation: 你的出现令海克斯感到不安。

entries.source: The Hex will not see you now.
If you find any more during your travels, please bring them back to me!
entries.translation: 旅途中要是再找到,请把它们带回来给我!
entries.sampleRaw: §fIf you find any more during your travels, please bring them back to me!

entries.source: They are the souls of my fallen sisters.
entries.translation: 那是我逝去的姐妹们的灵魂。
entries.sampleRaw: §fThey are the souls of my fallen sisters.

entries.source: You may have noticed some strange orbs laying around the island.
entries.translation: 你也许注意到了,岛上散落着一些奇怪的光球。
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou may have noticed some strange orbs laying around the island.

entries.source: ✆ Although I don't think technology can help with their communication problems...
entries.translation: ✆ 不过我觉得,他们之间的沟通问题,科技也帮不上忙……

entries.source: ✆ But hey, let's keep this between us!
entries.translation: ✆ 不过嘿,这事你知我知就行!

entries.source: ✆ But since so many of us are now missing, we're behind on maintenance!
entries.translation: ✆ 可我们失踪了太多姐妹,维护工作早就落下了!

entries.source: ✆ Call me and I can tell you where the first relay is!
entries.translation: ✆ 打给我,我告诉你第一个中继在哪儿!

entries.source: ✆ He said "Travel too far home. Bye." after installing it and never called again.
entries.translation: ✆ 他装完只说了句“回家路太远。拜。”,之后再没打过电话。

entries.source: ✆ I don't personally know what the maintenance procedure is, but I'm sure you can figure it out!
entries.translation: ✆ 维护流程我自己也不清楚,但我相信你能琢磨出来!

entries.source: ✆ If you face the cathedral, there is a relay at the top of the left tower.
entries.translation: ✆ 面朝大教堂,左边塔楼的顶上就有一个中继。

entries.source: ✆ It offers service to the whole village!
entries.translation: ✆ 整个村庄的信号都靠它!

entries.source: ✆ It's in a very high place to reverb the signal for the royal council.
entries.translation: ✆ 它装在很高的地方,好把信号传给王室议会。

entries.source: ✆ It's on the face which looks at the moon rising.
entries.translation: ✆ 在朝着月亮升起的那一面。

entries.source: ✆ Make sure to wear Fairy Armor!
✆ Maybe he can tell you where he put the relay?
entries.translation: ✆ 说不定他能告诉你中继装在哪儿?

entries.source: ✆ Or the sun! If you're that kind of person...
entries.translation: ✆ 或者说朝着太阳! 如果你是那种人的话……

entries.source: ✆ The first relay is on a branch of the large tree on the north-east of the fairy pond.
entries.translation: ✆ 第一个中继在仙女池塘东北边那棵大树的树枝上。

entries.source: ✆ The next relay is in the Royal Palace within the Dwarven Mines.
entries.translation: ✆ 下一个中继在矮人矿山的皇家宫殿里。

entries.source: ✆ The next relay is in the castle ruins!
entries.translation: ✆ 下一个中继在城堡废墟里!

entries.source: ✆ The next relay is on the highest spike of The End.
entries.translation: ✆ 下一个中继在末地最高的那根尖塔上。

entries.source: ✆ The next relay is on top of a statue in the dungeon hub.
entries.translation: ✆ 下一个中继在地牢大厅的一座雕像顶上。

entries.source: ✆ The next relay is on top of the Auction House.
entries.translation: ✆ 下一个中继在拍卖行的屋顶上。

entries.source: ✆ The next relay is on top of the shack next to the shady inn right here close to the pond.
entries.translation: ✆ 下一个中继就在池塘附近那家可疑小旅馆旁边的小屋顶上。

entries.source: ✆ The next relay was placed by our consultant, Odger.
entries.translation: ✆ 下一个中继是我们的顾问 Odger 装的。

entries.source: ✆ The one that doesn't have a fairy soul...
entries.translation: ✆ 就是没有仙女之魂的那座……

entries.source: ✆ They'll know if you tell anyone.
entries.translation: ✆ 你要是说出去,他们会知道的。

entries.source: ✆ Usually we wouldn't have a relay serve so few people, but we were paid generously by anonymous contributors!
entries.translation: ✆ 平时我们不会为这么少的人专门架一个中继,不过有匿名人士出手阔绰!

entries.source: ✆ Why is the tooth fairy so smart?
✆ Wow, you figured out the maintenance plan!
entries.translation: ✆ 哇,你把维护方案搞明白了!

entries.source: ✆ You need more contacts before you can deal with the next relay!
entries.translation: ✆ 你的联系人还不够多,还处理不了下一个中继!

entries.source: And then once they have decided on a new king he gets bored and names another new king almost instantly.
entries.translation: 可他们刚选出新国王，他转眼就会觉得无聊，几乎立刻又任命一位新国王。

entries.source: Most of their time is spent trying to decide who is going to be the next king.
entries.translation: 他们大部分时间都在设法决定下一任国王由谁来当。

entries.source: There isn't much going on in our caves at the moment so they don't have much to talk about.
entries.translation: 眼下我们的洞穴里没什么动静，所以他们也没多少可聊的。

entries.source: They're always sitting at this table. All day, every day...
entries.translation: 他们总是坐在这张桌旁，日复一日……

entries.source: Sacrifice your items at this Draconic Altar to obtain Dragon Essence and special items.
entries.translation: 在这座龙族祭坛献祭物品,即可获得巨龙精华和特殊物品。
entries.sampleRaw: §fSacrifice your items at this §cDraconic Altar §fto obtain §dDragon Essence §fand special items.

entries.source: You can then exchange this Essence with me for special perks that will aid you in your quest to slay the mighty Dragons.
entries.translation: 之后,你可以拿这些精华来找我兑换特殊天赋,它们会助你讨伐强大的巨龙。

styleMappings.You can then exchange this Essence with: 之后,你可以拿这些精华来找我兑换
styleMappings.that will aid you in your quest to slay: ,它们会助你讨伐强大的巨龙。

entries.sampleRaw: §fYou can then exchange this Essence with me for §dspecial perks §fthat will aid you in your quest to slay the mighty Dragons.

entries.source: And the sculk spread all over my body!
entries.translation: 结果幽匿爬满了我全身!
entries.sampleRaw: And the §5sculk §rspread all over my body!

entries.translation: 就连 Alatar 那么厉害的巫师……
也在某一天突然消失了!

entries.source: I was playing with a Sculk Catalyst in a different world from the future...
entries.translation: 我之前在一个来自未来的异世界里，摆弄了下幽匿催发体……

styleMappings.I was playing with a: 我之前在一个来自未来的异世界里，摆弄了下

entries.sampleRaw: I was playing with a §5Sculk Catalyst §rin a different world from the future...

entries.source: One second everything is fine and the next, the world is ending.
entries.translation: 上一秒还好好的，下一秒世界就要毁灭了。
entries.sampleRaw: One second everything is fine and the next, the world is ending.

entries.source: I'm working on a masterpiece currently. Want to take a look?
entries.translation: 我正在创作一件杰作。想看看吗?
entries.sampleRaw: I'm working on a masterpiece currently. Want to take a look?

entries.source: This piece is really starting to shape up.
entries.translation: 这幅画终于有点样子了。
entries.sampleRaw: This piece is really starting to shape up.

entries.source: The reward isn't in any of our chests.
entries.translation: 奖励不在我们任何一个人的箱子里。
entries.sampleRaw: The reward isn't in any of our chests.

entries.source: With the right tools, you can get through anything!
entries.translation: 工具用得对，什么障碍都挡不住你!
entries.sampleRaw: §fWith the right tools, you can get through anything!

entries.source: You'll need some strong weapons to survive out in the wild! Lucky for you, I've got some!
entries.translation: 想在野外生存,你需要强力的武器! 算你走运,我这里正好有!
entries.sampleRaw: §fYou'll need some strong weapons to survive out in the wild! Lucky for you, I've got some!

entries.source: If you didn't find the Wither Key yet, it probably means you need to go back!
entries.translation: 还没找到凋零钥匙? 那你大概得回头找找了!
entries.sampleRaw: If you didn't find the Wither Key yet, it probably means you need to go back!

entries.source: That's a door, and I keep the door...there.
entries.translation: 那是扇门，而我守着那扇门……就在那儿。
entries.sampleRaw: That's a door, and I keep the door...there.

entries.source: You need a Wither Key to open this door!
entries.translation: 得有凋零钥匙才能打开这扇门!
entries.sampleRaw: You need a Wither Key to open this door!

entries.source: ...why don't sheep get smaller when it rains?
entries.translation: ……那为什么羊淋雨不会变小呢?
entries.sampleRaw: §f...why don't sheep get smaller when it rains?

entries.source: If wool shrinks when you wash it...
entries.sampleRaw: §fIf wool shrinks when you wash it...

entries.source: And really, isn't that practically the next-best thing?
entries.translation: 说真的,这不就是退而求其次的最佳选择吗?
entries.sampleRaw: §fAnd really, isn't that practically the next-best thing?

entries.source: Have you ever wanted to change fate?
entries.translation: 你是否曾想过改变命运?
entries.sampleRaw: §fHave you ever wanted to change fate?

entries.source: Unsay something you shouldn't've, undo a mistake you've made?
entries.translation: 收回不该说的话,或是撤销犯下的错误?
entries.sampleRaw: §fUnsay something you shouldn't've, undo a mistake you've made?

entries.source: Eating enough of these surely should bring back my taste memories. Thank you.
entries.translation: 这些多吃点,肯定能把味觉的记忆找回来。谢谢你。
entries.sampleRaw: §fEating enough of these surely should bring back my taste memories. Thank you.

entries.source: Hello! Have you heard of pet items?
entries.translation: 你好! 你听说过宠物道具吗?
entries.sampleRaw: §fHello! Have you heard of pet items?

entries.source: I have a big problem. I lost my sense of taste, now I can't tell the difference between a melon and a cactus...
entries.translation: 我遇上大麻烦了。我的味觉没了,现在连西瓜和仙人掌都分不出来……
entries.sampleRaw: §fI have a big problem. I lost my sense of taste, now I can't tell the difference between a melon and a cactus...

entries.source: I sell all kinds of them if you'd like to try one out!
entries.translation: 我这里各式各样的都有,想试试的话就来买吧!
entries.sampleRaw: §fI sell all kinds of them if you'd like to try one out!

entries.source: My tongue is hurting for some reason...
entries.translation: 不知道怎么回事,我舌头疼……

entries.source: Pet items give your companions bonuses!
entries.translation: 宠物道具能为你的伙伴提供加成!

entries.source: ✆ I don't want to sound too gamey but...
entries.translation: ✆ 我不想显得太像在打游戏,不过……

entries.source: ✆ If you had 5 Max Lvl pets of Legendary tier or better in your pet menu...
entries.translation: ✆ 要是你的宠物菜单里有 5 只满级的传说或更高稀有度的宠物……

entries.source: ✆ Now there's both Kat AND you!
entries.translation: ✆ 现在里面有 Kat,还有你了!

entries.source: ✆ That would show me you're a pet lover too!
entries.translation: ✆ 那就说明你也是个宠物迷!

entries.source: ✆ Wow, you're a true pet lover!
entries.translation: ✆ 哇,你是货真价实的宠物迷!

entries.source: ✆ You doubled my HUGE contacts list too!
entries.translation: ✆ 你还让我那“庞大”的通讯录翻了一倍!

entries.translation: 2. 踩过的方块很快就会消失。

entries.translation: 2. 持续躲避火球即可获得分数。

留在平台上即可获得分数。

entries.translation: 2. 每 30 秒获得一种新的剑。

entries.translation: 2. 每次被击中会扣除 10 秒。

entries.translation: 2. 方块变红后很快就会消失!

entries.translation: 2. 左键射击，右键取消射击。
